completionRules: RecoveryEffect::finish is called only when no provider request started, or the entire provider operation succeeded and required private outcome persistence succeeded.
A provider error, timeout, accepted HTTP error, partial completion, process cancellation, or failed/disconnected metadata write leaves the opaque token untouched.
mailbox_ready and engine_state require UPDATE RETURNING exactly one row; missing/suppressed writes are errors, repeated matching writes succeed.
Mailbox provider failures retain honest failed state when possible; incomplete suspension stays suspending.

Crate-private read-only Store::recovery_effect_count returns installation-wide unresolved count; resume skips all automatic engine/mailbox reconciliation when nonzero, with mail_plugin_recovery_effect_uncertain diagnostic. It does not change gate state, release custody, or claim reconciliation succeeded.

Unresolved rows deny private drain and source resume and survive reconnect, process/PG restart, dump serialization and existing quarantine epoch change. Main owns Core/agent fence, known-runtime stop and restored-history quarantine.
